verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs describe installing Cognee as a Linear agent that answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory. That is a first-party assistant users can hand work to, but it lives inside Linear rather than inside Cognee itself, and its scope is answering questions from memory rather than doing general tasks. The browser UI and CLI support asking questions and running searches (with automatic retrieval-strategy selection), but nothing shows an in-product assistant that takes on and carries out multi-step work. Missing for 10: an assistant built into Cognee's own UI, delegation of tasks beyond Q&A, depth of documentation on the Linear agent's capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
